title: docs(pm-dispatch): mailbox progress knocks — `Request: progress` / `Notify: progress`, one per item per hour, idle read off progress
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBUyArWn6eHL33NNgvdpkwiW)_

Fixes #29754

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

**Rules text plus the mailbox reader.** Two mailbox keys join `MAILBOX_KEYS` in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`, three pm-dispatch reference files carry the ruled text, and three `CEILINGS` rows rise by the measured deltas. Nothing published moves (`skip-changeset`). No new gate, no new label, no new state.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:信箱新增一对键:分诊向认领席敲 `Request: progress · #n · idle since TIME`,认领席回 `Notify: progress · #n · record ID`。「⛔ 不敲:催」改成频率规则:同一项 60 分钟内只敲一次,答了 ETA 到期前不敲,已停车或等决策卡的项不敲。分诊每轮按「进展」(head 提交、非分诊评论、其席改标,不读 `updated_at`)扫闲置 ≥3h 的在飞卡和 open PR;两轮不答视为掉线,其卡与 PR 归同车道在线兄弟席,分诊只敲兄弟席一次、不代为释放。下班席的在飞同样交兄弟席。
- **为什么改**:您 2026-11-03 裁定 29775 A(「同意29775 A」)并补充「同意:下班席位的卡交给兄弟席」。此前技能禁止用信箱催,催只能写在 PR 或卡上:PR 上三分钟有人答,卡上三条催无人读;分诊也听不到回复。信箱是唯一可靠叫醒席位的通道。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 `.claude/**` 规则文本与 `scripts/pm/` 的读键表,无发布面、无门禁读信箱(信箱永不是合并条件)。回滚即还原本 PR。三个文件各抬 ratchet 上限(56→58、17→20、96→98),每一行都是裁决点名的文字,PR 正文逐条引记录号。
- **先看**:`project-forms.md` 第 48–50 行(新键行、频率行、改写的不敲行);`lanes/triage.md` 第 16–18 行(轮次步骤);`seat-lifecycle.md` 第 38、42–43 行(收班 `Release:`+`Resume-from:` 回队,兄弟席再认领)。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --mailbox-keys`,预期表头写 17 keys 且含两条 `progress` 模板;`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,预期 ✓(三个文件各在新上限,行宽 ≤120 字节)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(Tier S,`.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**`)。

## What changes

### `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` — the two keys and their self-test rows

- `MAILBOX_KEYS` gains `request:progress` (template `Request: progress · #n · idle since TIME`; from triage to the claiming seat, or to the online sibling an off-shift seat's items went to) and `notify:progress` (template `Notify: progress · #n · record ID`; from the claiming seat to triage). The `when` rows carry the rate (one per item per 60 min), the holds (an answered ETA; parked `Blocked-by:` / `Resume-from:`; a decision-card wait), the idle reading (progress, never `updated_at`) and the escalation (two unanswered ⇒ round record, seat read as possibly down), so `--mailbox-keys` prints the whole rule beside the spelling.
- `MAILBOX_FIELD_READERS`: `request:progress` reads the item (`#n`, bare, as a card OR a PR — `PR #n` does not read) and `idle since TIME` with `TIME` a `Z` time in `CLAIM_TIME`'s spelling (`2026-11-03T00:06Z`, seconds optional); `notify:progress` reads the item and `record ID` through the existing `RECORD_REF`. Both return `item`, so a reader can tell a card number from a PR number only by looking it up — which is the card's definition of "item".
- Self-test: a `⭐` row per key (the fixture reads; the placeholder `TIME`, a duration, a date without a time, a local-offset time, `PR #n`, a missing field and a fourth field are `unreadable` with `does not spell`; `record none`, `record ID`, an ETA in place of a record and a trailing field are `unreadable`). The roster pin moves 15 → 17 keys / 17 readers. The pins already in place cover the rest: every template sent verbatim is not an event, `--mailbox-keys` prints exactly `mailboxKeyLines()`, and every key of the table is named as a code span in 〈信箱 PR〉 and that section names no other key.
- The `MAILBOX_KEYS` doc comment records why the pair was admitted (ruling 「同意29775 A」, record 6595514258, amendments 6595244387 and 6595840476).

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉 (56 → 58 lines)

```diff
-- ⛔ 不敲:回执、重发、催(逾期归升级);收方订阅 PR 已载者;问维护者走决策卡。
+- 分诊→认领席:认领卡或 open PR 闲置 ≥3h `Request: progress`;反向随记录 `Notify: progress`。
+- 记录 = 项上写下一步与 ETA 的评论、§C 停车或释放;同项 60 分钟一敲,答 ETA 到期前不敲。
+- ⛔ 不敲:回执、重发;收方订阅 PR 已载者;停车或待决策卡的项的进度;问维护者走决策卡。
```

The key row names both keys as `Kind: key` code spans (the self-test pins the section against the table in both directions). The record/rate line is amendment 1's rule: what a `Notify: progress` record is (a comment on the item with the next act and an ETA, the §C park, or a release), one knock per item per 60 min, an answered ETA holds the clock until it passes. The 不敲 line loses 催(逾期归升级) — a nudge is now the key above, at that rate — and gains the two never-knocked cases (parked, decision-card wait) in their place.

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md` (17 → 20 lines)

```diff
+- 每轮扫 `pm:dispatched` 卡与非信箱 open PR,进展=head 提交/非分诊评论/其席改标,非 `updated_at`。
+- 进展逾 3h 即敲认领席 `Request: progress`,下轮读答复,无答列轮次记录;两轮无答视为掉线。
+- 掉线或下班席的项归在线兄弟席(`seat-lifecycle.md`),下轮敲兄弟席一次;⛔ 分诊永不释放。
```

The round step of Wanted item 3 as amended: the sweep population (dispatched cards and non-mailbox open PRs), the idle reading of amendment 2 item 1 (head commit, any non-triage comment, a label change by its seat — triage's own nudge bumps `updated_at` and would hide the item from a naive filter), the knock, the next-round read, the unanswered list, and the escalation: two silent rounds read the seat as down, its items go to an online sibling of the lane (the mechanics live in `seat-lifecycle.md`, which the third line points at), triage knocks the sibling once and never releases a claim. Push case ⑥ (the 6 h stale-PR push to the maintainer) is untouched: the knock is what happens before it.

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md` (96 → 98 lines)

```diff
-- 收班 = 状态 flush + 在飞默认交回队列、不等落地;派发口径失效,简报 ⛔ 不列作继承裁决。
+- 收班 = 状态 flush + 在飞 `Release:`+`Resume-from:` 回队待兄弟席、不等落地;简报非继承裁决。
 …
+- 下班席(`seat-offline`,或两敲 `Request: progress` 无答走接管四件)的在飞归同车道在线兄弟席。
+- 兄弟席 `Resume-from:` 引简报或轮次记录认领;待裁先等字;无兄弟席「待席」;安全归安全席。
```

Amendment 2 item 2 (「同意:下班席位的卡交给兄弟席」): the sign-off line keeps the transit `check-handover.mjs` (a) and `seat-post-protocol.md` 收尾 step 2 read — the departing seat releases its in-flight with `Release:` + `Resume-from:` back to `pm:queue` — and names the online sibling as the next claimant (round 1, seat should-fix 1); the two new lines say when the hand-over applies (sign-off, or two unanswered knocks, the latter through `execution-duties.md`'s existing 接管四件 shape), what the sibling cites in its `Resume-from:` claim (the sign-off brief, or triage's round record where no brief exists — round 1, should-fix 2) and the three exceptions (a decision-card wait waits for the letter first; no online sibling ⇒ 「待席」 on the round record; security items stay with the security seat). 「派发口径失效」 left line 38 to make room: it is implied by the brief not being an inherited ruling.

### `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` — three ceilings raised by the measured deltas

The header authorises a raise only by the ruling of record that orders text into the file, quoted in the raising PR with the measured delta, the row moved by at most that delta. Every target file sat at headroom 0 with every neighbouring line at 104–120 bytes, so no new rule could be folded into an existing line; the lines rewritten in place (the 不敲 line, the sign-off line, and in round 1 lines 42–43) were paid in place.

| file | ceiling | delta | lines the ruling orders | ruling of record |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `references/project-forms.md` | 56 → 58 | +2 | the key row (Wanted item 1, 「新增一对键」); the record/rate line (amendment 1) | #29775 record 6595514258 「同意29775 A」; amendment 6595244387 |
| `references/lanes/triage.md` | 17 → 20 | +3 | the sweep + idle reading (amendment 2 item 1); the knock/escalation (Wanted item 3 + amendment 1); the sibling hand-over (amendment 2 item 2) | record 6595514258; amendments 6595244387, 6595840476 「同意：下班席位的卡交给兄弟席」 |
| `references/seat-lifecycle.md` | 96 → 98 | +2 | when the hand-over applies; what the sibling cites and the exceptions (amendment 2 item 2, which names this file) | amendment 6595840476 under record 6595514258 |

None of the three is a `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` destination, so no `ruledRaises` record applies; each row's comment quotes the ids and the maintainer's words. Map total +7.

## Why

The mailbox is the one channel that reliably wakes a seat (a comment on the subscribed PR), and the text forbade using it to ask for progress. Measured on 2026-11-03: a nudge on a PR was answered in three minutes; three nudges on cards woke nobody; triage, subscribed only to its own mailbox, heard no reply either way. Ruling A on #29775 allows the knock at one per item per hour; amendment 2 fixes how "idle" is read (triage's own nudge bumps `updated_at`) and where an off-shift seat's items go.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` on the final head: ✓ 362 cases pass (360 before; the two new `⭐ progress` rows). Run again through `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers` (this file's own suite plus `check-owed-reviews`, `mailbox-open`, `fleet-roster` self-tests), which is also in the derived gate list below.
- No ablation: the diff adds readers and rules text; no tested behaviour of an existing key changed (the existing rows all still pass unchanged).

## Acceptance notes

- **Wanted item 4 (the per-seat cap ≤5).** Already the rule on the cap line (「每席每轮 ≤5 条,p0 豁免,超额归下轮,计入写节奏」), which the knock inherits as any key does; no byte was spent restating it.
- **Wording choices a reviewer may push back on.** `Request: progress` reads a bare `#n` for a PR too (the card's "item"), matching `serial`/`landed` rather than `contract-review`'s `PR #n`; `idle since` takes a `Z` time only (the spelling every `Claim:`/record stamp here already uses), never a duration; seat-lifecycle.md line 43 spells the security seat as 安全席 and the no-sibling case as 「待席」 to fit 120 bytes; 「待裁先等字」 stands for "items waiting on a decision card wait for the letter first".
- **Round 1 minor item not taken.** Narrowing `lanes/triage.md` line 16's sweep population to owned, non-Version PRs (as push ⑥ spells it) does not fit the line's 120 bytes without dropping the idle reading; push ⑥'s own exclusion list (two lines above) still governs what triage pushes, and the knock line (17) only fires on items with a claiming seat to address.
- **`check-skill-id-lint`.** The record and comment ids live in the PR body and in the ratchet's `CEILINGS` comments (a script header, outside the lint's corpus); the three rule files cite none.
- **Attribution thread link.** The order file spells the skills-lane seat thread in the attribution line, as this body carries it; the card thread is `cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBC6GLUUzuNXWcdKZZCu8ixr`.
- Out-of-scope findings: none.

## Verification

Every one of the 38 exited 0, among them `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`, `pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `pnpm check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`.

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (`IDLE_SINCE_REF`, `request:progress`, `notify:progress` follow their neighbours)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run (repo-level scan).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (`.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` are not published: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block and the rule text itself are Chinese by the dispatch contract; the quoted rulings stay verbatim)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
